sentences.text: Revenue compounded at 26.0% a year from $4.32 billion in FY2016 to $34.6 billion in FY2025 [F1][F10][F231].
Revenue rose 43.6% in FY2022 as Embedded revenue jumped from $246 million to $4.55 billion with the Xilinx acquisition [D314][S109][S110][P41].
Revenue then fell 3.9% to $22.7 billion in FY2023, as Client segment revenue dropped 25% on weak PC market conditions [D370][F8][P34].
Revenue rose 34.3% to $34.6 billion in FY2025, driven by the Data Center and Client and Gaming segments [D483][F10][P15].
Data Center contributed 15.7pp of FY2025's 34.3% revenue growth and was 48.0% of revenue [D694][D483][D692].
Data Center revenue rose 32% to $16.6 billion on strong demand for AMD EPYC processors and AMD Instinct GPU accelerators [S98][P13].
Client and Gaming added 19.0pp, with Client revenue up 51% on 31% more processor units and a 15% higher average selling price [D701][P10].
Embedded revenue fell 2.9%, a 0.4pp drag, as certain end market demand remained mixed [D730][D731][P15].
Operating income grew 94.4% against 34.3% revenue growth, an incremental operating margin of 20.3% [D484][D483][D511].
Operating margin of 10.7% sits above the 7.2% window median but far below the 22.2% high [F60][D795][D794].
Gross margin rose 0.2pp to 49.5%, the window high, on product mix despite about $440 million of MI308 export-control inventory charges [D498][F40][D800][P14].
In FY2025, R&D leverage added 1.7pp to operating margin and other lines added 2.6pp, while SG&A cost 1.2pp, though FY2024 SG&A was later recast lower [D514][D516][D515][X49].
The FY2022 operating margin fell 16.8pp, the window's largest drop, with gross margin down 3.3pp on amortization of Xilinx intangibles [D330][D329][P46].
Net margin of 12.5% topped operating margin of 10.7% because of a $103 million tax benefit from an $853 million release of uncertain tax positions [F80][F60][X113][P4].
Operating cash flow of $7.71 billion was 1.78x net income and free cash flow of $6.74 billion was 1.55x [F110][D470][F130][D471].
Free cash flow margin of 19.4% compares with a 6.5% window median [D467][D804].
Capex of $974 million was 2.8% of revenue and 1.87x D&A, up from 1.40x in FY2024 [F120][D466][D472][D415].

Working capital absorbed $2.4 billion, including a $2.2 billion inventory build for the Data Center ramp, and reported operating cash flow includes $1.2 billion from discontinued ZT Manufacturing [P3][F110].
Net cash rose to $6.46 billion in FY2025 from $3.41 billion in FY2024 [D476][D419].
Net cash of 18.6% of revenue ranks in the 100th percentile of six semis peers, whose median is -13.9% [D477][D826][D827].
Cash and investments grew 105.6% to $10.6 billion, against total debt of $4.10 billion [D507][D474][D475].
Buybacks of $1.32 billion used 19.5% of free cash flow, and diluted shares fell 0.1% [X150][D479][D506].
Inventory reached $7.92 billion, and days inventory outstanding hit 165 days against 83 days in FY2016 [X203][D481][D17].
The filings tie a $2.2 billion inventory increase to the Data Center ramp, and about $440 million of MI308 charges show the write-down risk [P3][P12].
Total debt rose 138% to $4.10 billion after $1.5 billion of notes issued in March 2025, though net cash of $6.46 billion limits the concern [R2][D475][P6][D476].

The effective tax rate of -2.5% against 18.8% in FY2024 reflects an $853 million uncertain-tax-position release, so net income growth of 164.2% outran operating income growth of 94.4% [R4][D469][D412][P4][D485][D484].
Return on average equity of 7.2% ranks in the 17th percentile against a 26.7% peer median, with goodwill 32.7% of total assets [D482][D830][D831][X223][F160].
Days inventory outstanding above FY2025's 165 days would confirm the inventory-build risk, and a fall below FY2024's 160 days would reverse it, in the FY2026 10-K [D481][D424].
Data Center segment operating margin above FY2025's 21.7% would show recovery toward FY2024's 27.7%, while a lower figure would reverse it, in the FY2026 10-K [D769][D768].
Free cash flow to net income falling below the 1.17x window median, from 1.55x in FY2025, would signal weaker conversion in the FY2026 10-K [D810][D471].
